capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Kia US 2027 EV9 page: 99.8 kWh on Light Long Range, Wind, Land, GT-Line.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: EV Database: 96.0 kWh usable (page marks it estimated); Australian Kia fact sheet also 96.

chemistry.notes: Both EV9 packs NMC (SK On) per EV Seekers; EV Database NMC for the 99.8 kWh pack.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Kia UK spec page: EV9 uses the 800-volt E-GMP system (needs an 800 V charger for max speed).

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: 2024 and 2026 EV9 manuals (MV1) describe the same switch plus navigation trigger; nothing shows a change between 2024 and 2027. Requires a battery heater (per-trim equipment not confirmed).

dc_max_kw.notes: Kia UK spec page: 10-80 % in 24 min at 210 kW (pack-level, not market-specific). InsideEVs (Kia US documents) says up to 215 kW and measured almost 215 kW; within 2.4 %.

ac_max_kw.notes: Kia US 2027 EV9 page: 10.9 kW on all trims.

published_10_80_min.notes: Kia US 2027 EV9 page: about 24 min 10-80 % at 350 kW (CCS); 34 min via NACS.
